'''Christinus''' is a Star Wars CCG writing handle on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]]. The DS II & Beyond index credited that handle for Force Drain By Death.<ref name="or">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/13dark.htm Force Drain By Death], The Outer Rim (Christinus). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261030143204/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/13dark.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
